note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our accounting profit before tax this year is $2,400,000. We need the corporate tax computation organised for our outside tax preparer, who will review, sign and file the return.

answers.common.decision: How much tax to provide for and what to give the preparer; the preparer signs and files the return.
answers.common.deadline: The preparer needs our pack in three weeks.
answers.common.audience: The finance director and our outside tax preparer.
answers.common.materials: Entertainment costs of $60,000 are not deductible. Tax depreciation exceeds book depreciation by $180,000. The tax rate is 21%. We paid $400,000 in estimated tax during the year.
answers.accounting-operations.systems: Our accounting system, the financial year just ended, standard chart of accounts.
answers.accounting-operations.approver: The finance director approves our numbers; the outside preparer signs and files the return.
